# SLS Nexus

> The official digital database and technical portal of SLS Consultants.

SLS Consultants is a structural, mechanical, and industrial engineering consultancy established in 2002. They provide high-fidelity engineering design, structural steel detailing, and industrial fired heater packages (API 560) for global refineries and petrochemical facilities.

## Services
- **Industrial Fired Heater Engineering**: Thermal and structural casing designs under API 560/530.
- **Civil & Structural Engineering**: Heavy structural framing, pipe racks, and warehouses.
- **Building Structural Design**: RCC residential, commercial, and college complexes (IS 456).
- **Industrial Equipment Engineering**: Pressure vessels, reformers, heat exchangers (ASME Sec VIII).
- **Engineering Drawings & Shop Drawings**: Precision AutoCAD detailing, nozzles, and GA layouts.
- **Structural Steel Detailing**: Tekla modeling and MTO take-offs.
- **Foundation Engineering**: Isolated footings, piles, and dynamic machinery concrete blocks.
- **Construction Engineering Support**: Site support, coordination, and structural verification.
- **Remaining Life Assessment (RLA)**: Inspection of aging stacks and columns (API 579).
- **Finite Element Analysis (FEA)**: Stress, fatigue, and vibration simulation.
- **Piping Support Design**: Piping layout routing and racks stress analysis.
- **Software & AI Solutions**: Custom Tekla/CAD plugins and automation scripts.
